verified_findings.title: Unauthenticated QR table-order can self-apply arbitrary discount up to 100% of subtotal — assertPosManualDiscountAllowed gates BOTH posOrderStore branches but NEITHER tableOrderStore branch
verified_findings.grep_evidence: Route table.dining-order registered top-level (routes/api.php:1473 group middleware=['installed','apiKey','localization']; POST at 1488 + throttle:20,1) — NO auth:sanctum, NO dine-in flag (grep config/ for dine_in_enabled = EMPTY; the 'dine-in disabled' mandate gates the POS operator UI floorplan, not this customer API). ApiKeyMiddleware.php:21-26 compares one static config('app.api_key') (client-distributed frontend key = effectively public). TableOrderRequest.php:24 authorize()=true; rules() line 39 discount=['nullable','numeric','min:0'] (only NEGATIVE rejected, positive accepted). Flow with PRICING_USE_SSOT=true (config/pricing.php:9 default): OrderService.php:1269-1288 tableOrderStore passes (float)$request->discount into PricingRequest::forTable (PricingRequest.php:70-81 context='table', manualDiscount passthrough). PricingService.php:339-343 — context in ['pos','table'] applies DiscountCalculator::manualDiscount, which (DiscountCalculator.php:22-29) returns the FULL requested value whenever requested<=subtotal with NO permission/cap. PricingService.php:351/355 finalTotal=max(0, subtotal+delivery-discount). OrderService.php:1459-1460 persists order->discount + order->total from the result. CORRECTED ASYMMETRY: grep confirms assertPosManualDiscountAllowed is called ONLY at lines 768 and 950, BOTH inside posOrderStore (method boundary verified: posOrderStore 612-1245, tableOrderStore 1246+). `awk NR>=1246&&NR<=1500 /assertPosManualDiscountAllowed/` = EMPTY → zero gate anywhere in tableOrderStore. So the real shape is: both POS branches gated, both TABLE branches ungated (the table-legacy branch 1444-1451 only clamps <=subtotal, no auth). assertPosManualDiscountAllowed (2672) fails-closed on null user (2690 throws 'Authentication required') — but it is never reached on the table path. Test gap: tests/Feature/TableOrderNegativeTotalTest.php:104-140 only asserts discount=-2 -> 422 (negative via min:0); NO test asserts a POSITIVE customer discount (e.g. discount==subtotal) is rejected — production allows what the suite never checks. NF525 scope (verified, NOT automatic): tableOrderStore creates the order at OrderService.php:1256 with status=PENDING and allocates NO fiscal_sequence_no (no allocation site in tableOrderStore). The under-priced total reaches the signed Z ONLY IF the order is subsequently counter-paid via PaymentService.php:321-322, which allocates fiscal_sequence_no via FiscalSequenceService::next() and flips PAID — after which order->total is folded into the signed aggregate (ZReportService::applyOrderToTotals:632). The per-line composition_snapshot item prices stay correct; the bogus value is the order-level discount/total.
verified_findings.recommendation: Pricing-SSOT/authz breach: PricingService is backend SSOT but the discount INPUT is never authorized on the public QR surface. Fix entirely in OrderService.php tableOrderStore (NOT a §7 frozen file; PricingService/DiscountCalculator untouched): a QR customer must never self-discount — force manualDiscount=0 when building PricingRequest::forTable for the dining-order surface (allow only coupon_id-driven discounts), OR mirror the POS path by calling assertPosManualDiscountAllowed (already fails-closed on null user) when coupon_id<=0 on BOTH table branches. Add a regression test: positive discount on POST /api/table/dining-order with no auth -> 422 / discount ignored. Practical-exposure caveat for V1 Le Cayenne single-resto (note, do NOT downgrade below P1): the QR dine-in customer frontend is not the primary V1 surface, but the API endpoint is genuinely live and reachable with the client-distributed apiKey regardless of frontend deployment.

verified_findings.title: z_reports.total_ht stores a TTC figure (not HT) in default TTC mode — signed + 6-year-archived NF525 record carries a wrong HT/TVA/TTC decomposition (total_ht + total_tva != total_ttc)
verified_findings.grep_evidence: ZReportService.php:633 does `$totalHt += $sign * (float)($order->total_ht ?? ($order->subtotal ?? 0))`. WIDENED grep `grep -rn total_ht app/` confirms total_ht exists ONLY on ZReport (model fillable:25 + cast:52, migration 2026_04_22_000003_create_z_reports_table.php:40) and inside ZReportService — there is NO orders.total_ht column (grep migrations: only z_reports), NO getTotalHtAttribute and NO $appends on Order.php or FrontendOrder.php (both EMPTY for total_ht). So $order->total_ht is ALWAYS null -> falls back to $order->subtotal. In default production mode PRICING_TAX_INCLUSIVE=true (config/pricing.php:31), subtotal is the sum of TTC line totals (tax INSIDE — PricingService.php:347-351 documents this), so the persisted+signed total_ht is actually a TTC figure, overstated by the tax. The aggregate (containing total_ht, line 427) is BOTH HMAC-signed (sign() at 239 -> SealingService::signZReport) AND persisted via forceFill(array_merge($aggregates,...))->save() at 241-247, and archived whole by FiscalArchiveCommand:307-308 ($row->toArray(), no column projection). Masking confirmed: fiscal test fixtures set total_tax=0 (NF525ComplianceE2ETest.php:141,339; FiscalVerifyChainCommandTest.php:397-399; FiscalAllocOrphanRetryTest.php:166) so HT==TTC and the divergence is invisible; assertions only check total_ttc (NF525ComplianceE2ETest.php:251,283,352,598); grep for any total_ht+total_tva==total_ttc reconciliation assertion = EMPTY. total_ttc (line 632, order->total) and total_tva (line 634, order->total_tax) remain correct — only total_ht fails to reconcile, a bug signature not a design choice.
verified_findings.recommendation: Make the HT/TVA/TTC decomposition reconcile in the signed+archived NF525 record. ZReportService.php IS a §7 frozen file, so the cleanest fix is OUTSIDE it: add a real HT basis on orders — either an orders.total_ht column populated at creation by PricingService (HT = subtotal - total_tax in TTC mode), or an Order getTotalHtAttribute accessor (subtotal - total_tax in TTC mode, subtotal in HT mode) so the existing `$order->total_ht ?? subtotal` fallback at line 633 resolves to a true HT figure with NO edit to the frozen service. If the derivation must live in applyOrderToTotals, that requires a LOCK on ZReportService. Note already-signed historical Z rows cannot be retro-corrected (chain integrity); document a corrective forward note. Track as a fiscal-accuracy backlog item with owner gate (touches a frozen file or adds a fiscal column).

verified_findings.title: Cash/TPE reconciliation enrichment layer is GREEN in 7 test files but has ZERO production wiring — the green suite masks a dead path; z_reports.cash_* columns stay NULL forever
verified_findings.grep_evidence: Discriminating grep `grep -rnE '->enrich\(|->enrichClose\(|->persistForClosedReport\(|->aggregateByTerminal\(|->verifyConsistencyVsAuditLog\(|new ZReportCashEnrichmentService|app\(ZReportCashEnrichmentService' app/ routes/ resources/` returns ONLY the service's own internal self-call (line 113 aggregateByTerminal inside enrich) — NO external prod caller. `grep -rln ZReportCashEnrichmentService tests/` = 7 test files (ZReportTerminalBreakdownTest, NF525ComplianceE2ETest, ZReportCashEnrichmentTest, TerminalIdWireInTest, F009KioskCashCounterDeferredInvariantSentinelTest, F003CashReconciliationSentinelTest, ZReportCashEnrichmentSentinelTest) that DO exercise enrich/persist/aggregateByTerminal. ZReportController.php show()/index()/pdf() return the raw ZReport model (lines 40,70,86-93) — never call enrich(). `grep -rlnE 'by_terminal|net_after_fees|cash_variance' resources/js/` = EMPTY (no UI consumes enriched fields). `grep -rn ZReportClosed app/` = only the service's own docblock at line 288 ('there is no ZReportClosed event in the codebase yet, so no listener is wired'). The daily close path (FiscalCloseAllActiveBranchesCommand) calls ZReportService::close() only — never persistForClosedReport(). Result: the per-TPE fee breakdown + net_after_fees + cash_variance-per-Z-window observability is unreachable in prod, while 7 tests assert it works.
verified_findings.recommendation: Observability/reconciliation gap, NOT fiscal-correctness: the SIGNED Z aggregates (total_ttc/ht/tva/by_method/by_tax_rate) from the frozen ZReportService::aggregate are intact and chain-verified (CHAIN OK); pricing SSOT untouched. Decide explicitly: (a) wire enrich() into ZReportController::show + persistForClosedReport() into the close path (recommend a ZReportClosed event + listener so the §7-frozen ZReportService is not edited), OR (b) formally retire the service + z_reports.cash_* columns + the 7 tests and track as cloud-prep backlog. Until decided, the green suite gives false confidence that admins can see per-TPE fees / cash variance — they cannot. Do NOT raise severity for the 588-LOC size; NF525 chain correctness is unaffected. Confirms prior-audit ORPHANED status (is_new=false).

verified_findings.title: Z total_by_tax_rate raw query omits deleted_at filter — latent total_tva vs Sum(total_by_tax_rate) divergence IF order_item-level soft-deletes ever occur post-seal
verified_findings.grep_evidence: ZReportService.php:651-656 uses DB::table('order_items')->selectRaw('tax_rate, SUM(tax_amount)')->whereIn('order_id')->whereNotNull('tax_rate')->groupBy('tax_rate') with NO whereNull('deleted_at'). OrderItem uses SoftDeletes (app/Models/OrderItem.php:8 import, :13 use SoftDeletes). applyOrderToTotals derives total_tva from the ORDER-level total_tax column (line 634) while total_by_tax_rate sums per-LINE order_items.tax_amount. If a single order_item is soft-deleted after the order's total_tax was recomputed, the per-rate breakdown would still count the deleted line's tax while order-level total_tva would not — yielding a signed Z where total_tva != Sum(total_by_tax_rate). NOT currently exploitable: composition_snapshot is frozen at creation and enforced immutable by OrderItem::updating guard (OrderItem.php:50-58, throws RuntimeException on post-creation mutation of a non-null snapshot); no production path soft-deletes individual order_items after sealing.
verified_findings.recommendation: Defense-in-depth hardening observation, not a confirmed breach. Mirror the orders-query semantics in taxBreakdownForOrders (add ->whereNull('order_items.deleted_at') if line-level exclusion is intended, or document that the divergence cannot arise because post-seal line soft-deletes are forbidden by the OrderItem immutability guard). ZReportService.php IS a §7 frozen file — any change requires a LOCK; recommend tracking as backlog rather than touching now given zero current exploit.
